description: Create a NEW tournament as an organizer — step 1 of the organizer flow: create_tournament → import_players → generate_bracket → schedule_matches → report_result. Takes effect immediately (no preview step). Returns the new tournament's id, share_url and manage_code. SAVE the manage_code and show it to the user: it is the write credential for every organizer tool on this tournament (import_players, generate_bracket, schedule_matches, report_result, screen_show, screen_clear, delete_tournament) and cannot be recovered later.

entry_fee.description: Entry fee as display text, e.g. '$20' or 'Free'

location.description: Venue / city text shown to players

name.description: Tournament name as shown to players

start_date.description: First day of the event, YYYY-MM-DD

name: create_tournament
